_about: Statistics used by the foundation agent in the template deck. Session builders record theirs in data/sources.json with the same fields; the head agent may merge this file into it.

sources.claim_as_shown: India had 1,002.85 million internet subscriptions at the end of June 2025, up from 969.10 million three months earlier.
sources.title: Indian Telecom Services Performance Indicator Report for the Quarter April to June 2025, Press Release No. 86/2025, Executive Summary point 1
sources.note: Read on page 2 of the PDF: 'Total number of Internet subscribers increased from 969.10 million at the end of Mar-25 to 1002.85 million at the end of Jun-25, registering a quarterly rate of growth 3.48%.' Subscriptions, not people: one person can hold more than one.
